title: Crossvine Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in the Camp Watercolor District on a quiet cul-de-sac, this 4 bedroom 4 bath home features a renovated kitchen, designer furnishings, 2 king master suites, a bunk room, and 1300 sq ft of porch space. This home sleeps 10 comfortably!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: * This home adheres to the Watercolor Rental Advertising Policies and Guidelines:* * Maximum Certified Number of Guests for this home is 10 * Up to 10 wristbands are included to access Watercolor’s 5 pools, including the Beach Club pool and Camp Watercolor, as well as access to the private beach. The wristbands are issued to registered guests that are staying at the home, and strictly limited by the home’s Maximum Certified Number of Guests. * This home has a private driveway and includes 2 Watercolor parking passes to use throughout Watercolor in designated locations - Short walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - NEW 6 seater golf cart included** - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included** - Gas grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Private beach with seasonal tram service - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Use of owner's golf cart with signed liability waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). This gorgeous 4 bedroom, 4 bath home located in the Camp District on a private cul-de-sac is a must see! Renovated and professionally designed, this 2-story home invites comfort, and exudes a down-to-earth beach vibe. Prime location only steps to the newly expanded Camp Watercolor. The 1st floor features 12ft ceilings, an open concept great room, abundant windows & beautiful hardwood floors. The gourmet kitchen has been completely renovated with high end finishes and appliances that will inspire your inner chef with its granite countertops, gas cooktop, farmhouse sink, and counter seating for 4. This home features over 1300 SF of porches and is located on a quiet cul-de-sac with forest in the rear, lovely pond views to the side and a small park out front. Short stroll to Camp WaterColor, the tennis courts, the WaterColor Beach Club or many other Watercolor amenities. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 10) First floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, Flat screen TV, and private bath Second Floor: Bedroom 2: . King bed, Flat screen TV, private full bath with marble throughout, jetted tub and walk-in steam shower. , private balcony with seating Bedroom 3: King bed, Flat screen TV, private full bath with marble throughout, jetted tub and walk-in steam shower. Bedroom 4: Twin over twin bunk room with en suite bathroom ** This cottage comes with use of the owner's 6-seater golf cart with signed waiver and an up front REFUNDABLE deposit of $1000 to cover any incidental damages. If the golf cart(s) become unusable during your stay there will NOT be a replacement offered. We will do our best to fix the issue in a timely fashion. You must be 25+ yrs old to drive the golf cart. ** No pets allowed ** 2 Complimentary bikes included **Fireplace is aesthetic only and not for guest use *Certification Number: 063128 TDT#26360 FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
